**New**
- Memory Track manager: Settings > Saves > Memory Track lists every file on the cartridge (game and file name, size), shows free space, and lets you delete a single save or erase everything. Select twice to confirm a delete. It works on the same file the games use, so changes show up the next time a CD game starts.

**Known issues**
- The manager is a JagDroid screen, not the original on-console manager (hold Option at power-on), which isn't emulated.
- Aliens vs Predator: no music on the character-select screen.
- Ruiner Pinball graphics glitches.
